Here, the algorithm uses the raw Δ_LS(X) with no smoothing or certified neighbor-stable bound.

Therefore, the release conditional on acceptance is not guaranteed to be ε-DP, and combining with the ε, δ from T does not yield (2ε, 2δ)-DP in general.
